nodes.label: BDNF
props: Important signaling molecule that activates signaling cascades downstream of NTRK2. During development, promotes the survival and differentiation of selected neuronal populations of the peripheral and central nervous systems.

nodes.label: P2RX4
props: ATP-gated nonselective transmembrane cation channel permeable to potassium, sodium and calcium. CTP, but not GTP or UTP, functions as a weak affinity agonist for P2RX4.

references.title: BoNT/A alleviates neuropathic pain in osteoarthritis by down-regulating the expression of P2X4R in spinal microglia.
references.note: rat MIA OA: MIA raises P2X4R and BDNF in the spinal dorsal horn (P2X4R localised to microglia), both reversed by BoNT/A with pain relief; a toxin study, the only paper placing spinal P2X4 in OA

references.title: Spinal microglial activation in a murine surgical model of knee osteoarthritis.
references.note: mouse knee OA (DMM): spinal microglia activated, the cell the receptor is drawn on

references.title: ATP induced brain-derived neurotrophic factor expression and release from osteoarthritis synovial fibroblasts is mediated by purinergic receptor P2X4.
references.note: human OA synovial fibroblasts: ATP acts through P2X4 (siRNA) and p38 to raise and release BDNF; the whole chain in human OA cells, but not microglia

references.title: P2X4 receptors induced in spinal microglia gate tactile allodynia after nerve injury.
references.note: rat nerve injury: P2X4 induced in hyperactive spinal microglia, blocking it reverses allodynia

references.title: Identification and characterization of a selective allosteric antagonist of human P2X4 receptor channels.
references.note: recombinant human P2X4 and native P2X4 of human THP-1 macrophages: ATP-gated, concentration-response to ATP measured

references.title: BoNT/A alleviates neuropathic pain in osteoarthritis by down-regulating the expression of P2X4R in spinal microglia.
references.note: rat MIA OA: spinal microglial P2X4R drives BDNF, the step after the Ca2+ entry; the OA cover for the chain

references.title: ATP induced brain-derived neurotrophic factor expression and release from osteoarthritis synovial fibroblasts is mediated by purinergic receptor P2X4.
references.note: human OA synovial fibroblasts: ATP through P2X4 and p38 to BDNF (calcium not measured there)

references.title: Acidic amino acids impart enhanced Ca2+ permeability and flux in two members of the ATP-gated P2X receptor family.
references.note: human (and rat) P2X4 in HEK-293 cells, patch-clamp photometry: P2X4 carries a large fraction of Ca2+ current

references.title: Identification and characterization of a selective allosteric antagonist of human P2X4 receptor channels.
references.note: human P2X4: ATP-evoked calcium uptake in a cell line and in human THP-1 derived macrophages, blocked by the selective antagonist BX430

references.title: P2X4-receptor-mediated synthesis and release of brain-derived neurotrophic factor in microglia is dependent on calcium and p38-mitogen-activated protein kinase activation.
references.note: rat cultured microglia: P2X4 activation raises intracellular Ca2+, the step as drawn in microglia

Serine/threonine kinase which acts as an essential component of the MAP kinase signal transduction pathway. MAPK14 is one of the four p38 MAPKs which play an important role in the cascades of cellular responses evoked by extracellular stimuli such as pro-inflammatory cytokines or physical stress leading to direct activation of transcription factors.

Extracellular signal-regulated kinase 6; Mitogen-activated protein kinase p38 gamma; Stress-activated protein kinase 3

Serine/threonine kinase which acts as an essential component of the MAP kinase signal transduction pathway. MAPK12 is one of the four p38 MAPKs which play an important role in the cascades of cellular responses evoked by extracellular stimuli such as pro-inflammatory cytokines or physical stress leading to direct activation of transcription factors such as ELK1 and ATF2.
Mitogen-activated protein kinase p38 delta; Stress-activated protein kinase 4

references.title: Monosodium iodoacetate-induced joint pain is associated with increased phosphorylation of mitogen activated protein kinases in the rat spinal cord.
references.note: rat MIA OA: p38 phosphorylation raised in the spinal dorsal horn, in microglia and some neurons, with increased microglia

references.title: ATP induced brain-derived neurotrophic factor expression and release from osteoarthritis synovial fibroblasts is mediated by purinergic receptor P2X4.
references.note: human OA synovial fibroblasts: blocking p38 (not p44/42) stops the ATP-driven BDNF induction, so p38 lies downstream of P2X4 in human OA cells

references.title: P2X4-receptor-mediated synthesis and release of brain-derived neurotrophic factor in microglia is dependent on calcium and p38-mitogen-activated protein kinase activation.
references.note: rat cultured microglia: the P2X4-evoked Ca2+ rise is needed for p38 activation (calcium chelation and p38 inhibition tested)

nodes.label: BDNF
props: Important signaling molecule that activates signaling cascades downstream of NTRK2. During development, promotes the survival and differentiation of selected neuronal populations of the peripheral and central nervous systems.

references.title: BoNT/A alleviates neuropathic pain in osteoarthritis by down-regulating the expression of P2X4R in spinal microglia.
references.note: rat MIA OA: spinal BDNF rises with P2X4R and falls with it under BoNT/A, with pain relief

references.title: ATP induced brain-derived neurotrophic factor expression and release from osteoarthritis synovial fibroblasts is mediated by purinergic receptor P2X4.
references.note: human OA cells (synovial fibroblasts): ATP through P2X4 and p38 raises BDNF mRNA and releases BDNF protein

references.title: P2X4-receptor-mediated synthesis and release of brain-derived neurotrophic factor in microglia is dependent on calcium and p38-mitogen-activated protein kinase activation.
references.note: rat cultured microglia: p38 inhibition blocks the synthesis and exocytotic release of BDNF after P2X4 activation

references.title: Up-regulation of P2X4 receptors in spinal microglia after peripheral nerve injury mediates BDNF release and neuropathic pain.
references.note: mouse: no ATP-evoked BDNF release from P2X4-deficient microglia; the release is P2X4 dependent

references.title: BDNF from microglia causes the shift in neuronal anion gradient underlying neuropathic pain.
references.note: rat: ATP-stimulated microglia release BDNF, which shifts the anion gradient of lamina I neurons (the block's outgoing BDNF)
